history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-main-pbd-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: the owner asked for an experiment with a few arms of borg_param_attack_arrow_point_blank_divisor (1, 2, 5) with the standard settings and current main, pilot (borg-zoo#186). Small only after the pilot gate and the owner (RULES 14).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read (borg-zoo#186). Pilot only (RULES 14); small (or
verysmall) only after this gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's
borg.txt has borg_param_attack_arrow_point_blank_divisor at its value (1, 2, 5) and otherwise the
shipped settings, with no borg_plan; params-core.json reports the same value on the death replays;
every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn stalls and key outliers are listed.
Report per arm: deaths, final level, deepest level, keys; for pbd1 and pbd5 against pbd2 on the same
start: rescued, newly killed, and how many starts play identical keys (the divisor only acts when a
launcher is weighed against an adjacent monster, so many starts should not differ). Cross-check:
pbd5 is the same binary and effective settings as borg-zoo#181's reborn-shipped-defaults on
fdaf18e5; where that pilot's results exist, each pbd5 cell's play hash is compared with it and any
difference is listed. 18 starts per arm cannot show which divisor is better.
experiment.question: With main's shipped settings, how does the point-blank arrow divisor (1, 2, 5) change play?
